text:
Dan R.: Hey — quick T&E question from my Tokyo trip. Flight delayed 26h, missed hotel check-in, hotel charged a no-show fee of JPY 36,000 and wouldn't refund. Also my company card was flagged and blocked in Japan so I paid taxi and dinner on personal card.
Dan R.: Questions: 1) Is the hotel no-show fee reimbursable? 2) How do I submit payments in JPY + USD? 3) Any VAT reclaim for Japanese hotel charges? 4) Do I get full per-diem if I arrived after midnight?
travel-bot: Automated note: please attach original hotel folio, bank decline screenshot, and boarding pass showing delayed arrival.
People Ops (Liam): Short answers up front: 1) Hotel no-show fees are reimbursable if you can show the flight delay/cancellation that caused missing the check-in AND you attempted to cancel within policy window. 2) Submit each charge as separate line items in the portal with original currency and attach receipts. 3) Japan does not typically have reclaimable hotel VAT for short-stay domestic business, but include the itemized folio and finance will review. 4) Per-diem: arrival after 00:00 local = full overnight counts if you stayed overnight in destination; if you arrived after midnight and did not stay overnight, follow same-day split rules.
Finance Team: Process details: please include these attachments: hotel_folio.pdf, airline_notice.jpg, company_card_decline.png, personal_card_receipts.pdf, boarding_pass.png.
Finance Team: Use these exact fields when filing (copy/paste):
```
expense_type: hotel_no_show_fee
amount: 36000
currency: JPY
merchant: Shinjuku Grand Hotel
date: 2025-09-12
payment_method: personal_card
attachments: hotel_folio.pdf, airline_notice.jpg, decline_screenshot.png
note: PNR XYZ789 025-09-12 flight delayed; attempted cancellation at 09:02 local; manager pre-approval attached.
```
Finance Team: For multi-currency: enter each expense in original currency and the portal will auto-convert. If you need manual override, attach an XE/OANDA screenshot of the rate on charge date.
Dan R.: Manager Priya approved emergency overnight changes and wrote an email. I attached it. The hotel says no refunds for no-show if cancellation after 18:00 local previous day. I tried calling but flight diverted.
Manager (Priya): Confirmed I approved given the disruption. Marked "manager_approved" in the email thread.
Emma (Travel Ops): A couple of practical notes: 1) If the corporate card was blocked due to fraud, Finance can reverse-company-charge logic once the hotel posts to corporate ledger; attach the bank decline message so we can flag card provider. 2) For taxi/dinner on personal card, submit as separate expenses with merchant names and timestamps.
Dan R.: ETA on reimbursement? I used a travel advance for the trip (USD 800). How does that reconcile with these charges?
Finance Team: We'll process within standard 10 business days after full docs. Travel advance will be netted in final settlement. Show the advance ID in the expense notes (advance_4231). If net negative, you'll receive reimbursement; if net positive, we'll request refund.
Dan R.: VAT follow-up: hotel folio shows a line "consumption tax" JPY 2,880. Worth claiming?
Finance Team: Include the folio. Finance will review, but for Japan short-stay consumer tax is rarely reclaimable unless we have a VAT-registered invoice. We still check for larger invoices.
Bank-Bot: System: card 4000xxxx blocked for suspicious international use at 2025-09-12 04:10 JST. Submit bank decline screenshot to ops.
People Ops (Liam): Final checklist for you to upload: 1) boarding pass + airline schedule change email 2) hotel folio + no-show policy screenshot 3) manager approval email 4) company card decline screenshot 5) all personal card receipts 6) travel advance ID.
Dan R.: Thanks all 10x. Uploading now. :thumbsup:
travel-bot: Reminder: max 10MB per file; acceptable types PDF/JPEG/PNG.
